component.name: Halyard
component.summary: Fast terminal built to host coding agents

description.p: Halyard is a GPU-accelerated terminal that uses Ghostty's VT engine for correct emulation. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode and Gemini CLI run in it as ordinary terminal programs, and every AI-related feature can be switched off.
Halyard is early software. It has no account, no telemetry and makes no network calls.
In this package your shell runs on the host system, outside the Flatpak sandbox, as it does in any other terminal. The sandbox does not confine the programs you run in Halyard.
First published preview. Same features as 0.1.0, whose tag produced no release files because of a packaging fault in the release workflow.
First preview release: Ghostty VT engine, GPU rendering, tabs, splits, themes, saved workspaces, shell integration, agent attention and the session API.
